example.title: 15-27 North Main Street (Commercial Buildings), 23 North Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-287-C (photos via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS WIS,70-OSH,3C-)

brief: Narrow three-storey Queen Anne commercial front of dark brick with bands of patterned brick, round-arched windows on the top floor and a corbelled parapet; one of the few buildings to survive the 1875 fire, remodelled 1884-85 as a saloon and hall. The ground floor is a gutted shopfront with a recessed door between neighbours selling paint and wallpaper.
